--2.1 (Total MTD ADB)
SELECT BUSC.DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB.AVE_CURR_BALANCE, BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.CORE_CUST_ID
FROM BUSC.DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB
INNER JOIN BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP ON BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP.ACID = BUSC.DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB.ACID
INNER JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS ON BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.CORE_CUST_ID = BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP.CUST_ID
WHERE 
BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J') AND
BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP.isLatest = 1 AND
BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP.isActive = 1
GROUP BY BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.CORE_CUST_ID, BUSC.DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB.AVE_CURR_BALANCE

--2.2 (YTD ADB), Business Date Jan 30,2023
SELECT BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL/30 AS YTDABD, BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.CORE_CUST_ID
FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES
INNER JOIN BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP ON BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP.ACID = BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES.ACID
INNER JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS ON BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.CORE_CUST_ID = BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP.CUST_ID
WHERE 
BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J') AND
BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP.isLatest = 1 AND
BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP.isActive = 1 AND
BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES.CURRENT_EOD_DATE = '20230130'
GROUP BY BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.CORE_CUST_ID, BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL

--2.3 (Total Outstanding Balance)
SELECT BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE.TRAN_DATE_BAL, BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.CORE_CUST_ID
FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE
INNER JOIN BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP ON BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP.ACID = BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE.ACID
INNER JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS ON BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.CORE_CUST_ID = BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP.CUST_ID
WHERE 
BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J') AND
BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP.isLatest = 1 AND
BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP.isActive = 1
GROUP BY BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.CORE_CUST_ID, BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE.TRAN_DATE_BAL
